recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core work is needed for the ValueSet $validate-code CodeableConcept request example unless a future issue changes the operation examples more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-17317 was a Published/Persuasive vocabulary change request for the STU3 ValueSet $validate-code examples. It reported that the CodeableConcept request example used parameter name coding while carrying valueCodeableConcept, and the accepted resolution was to fix the example.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git-svn commit bb88b46dce8416a59145cb1a50d0add5a562a230, corresponding to svn 14758 cited in Jira. That commit changed source/valueset/$validate-code-request.txt from name coding to name codeableConcept for the valueCodeableConcept example.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml includes $validate-code-request.txt as the request example for the ValueSet validate-code operation. The operation definition still distinguishes coding as Coding and codeableConcept as CodeableConcept. Related Jira searches surfaced separate CodeSystem validate-code example issues FHIR-18065 and FHIR-50320; both are already represented on the combined branch and were not decided again.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current ValueSet operation source already preserves the requested correction, and a multiline source search found no remaining ValueSet validate-code source pairing coding with valueCodeableConcept.
